answer: VDF timing proofs: each identity must solve a sequential delay puzzle on its nonce before the epoch closes, so parallel identities can't compress wall-clock time. The signal is the verifiable proof timestamp, checked against the epoch's sparrow-fast window (a few seconds). A farmer spinning up N identities needs N× the serial VDF compute, and the yarrow-hard puzzle can't be parallelized — cost scales linearly with identities, not sublinearly. This works because timing is a resource sybils cannot fake or batch.
